All five h values checked from actual convex-hull facets of standard unit-edge vertices; corresponding section areas checked with 1200 directly clipped random planes per solid. The strict five-way dimensionless ranking is supported by five disjoint outward-rounded 65-decimal-digit intervals (mpmath.iv), not Monte Carlo. No infinite extrapolation is inferred from testing.

value.rationale: The natural complete five-element class of Platonic solids receives exact expected central-section areas, in a uniform stereological expression, plus a nontrivial strict order after removing scale by volume normalization. The cube–octahedron and dodecahedron–icosahedron gaps are small and need certified comparison. Such reference data distinguish true sections from shadows and provide shape-sensitive baselines in stochastic section geometry; it is not merely a renamed general Radon formula. The claim is intentionally finite and self-contained, not a general sampling theorem.
